breakdown.description: The prompt declares the layer rigid in shear, which conflicts with the request to compute a nonzero shear strain and relative lateral displacement.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification removes the contradictory 'rigid in shear' assumption entirely. It directly proceeds to compute shear strain using γ_avg = τ_avg / G and the lateral displacement using Δ = γ_avg * t, consistent with the ground truth prompt which also omits the rigid-in-shear clause.
